name: Masco
description: Masco makes branded home-improvement products in two segments: plumbing (Delta, Hansgrohe, Brizo, Kraus faucets and showers, plus spas) and decorative architectural products (Behr paint, which is sold only through The Home Depot in North American retail, plus Liberty cabinet and door hardware). It sells mostly to home centers, online retailers and wholesalers rather than to homeowners directly, so a single customer, The Home Depot, was about 38 percent of 2025 net sales ($2.9B). Revenue is repair-and-remodel driven (paint and faucets replaced by owners and pros) with a smaller new-construction share. 2025 sales were $7.56B (-3 percent) with segment operating profit of $1.34B (-8 percent).

sub.name: Home improvement, building products and timber

gics.note: Sector and sub-industry per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies'; industry group and industry not given there.

businessLines.name: Plumbing Products
businessLines.how: Sells branded products to home centers, online retailers, wholesalers and distributors who resell to plumbers, contractors, remodelers and consumers; one-time product sales, repeat through replacement and remodel cycles and new housing. Brass and copper input costs and tariffs drive margin.
businessLines.description: Faucets, showerheads, valves, bath hardware, bathing units and shower enclosures, sinks, water filtration, brass and PEX plumbing components, connected water products, and spas, exercise pools and saunas. Sold in North America, Europe and China.

operatingProfit.note: FY2024 $911M. Share is of segment total $1,338M before general corporate expense of $89M; shares and margin computed. Six months to 2026-06-30 segment profit $595M vs $509M; the 2026 figure includes about $95M of IEEPA tariff refunds, principally in this segment.

businessLines.name: Decorative Architectural Products
businessLines.how: Behr paint is sold to do-it-yourself and professional customers through The Home Depot under brand exclusivity (the segment's largest customer); hardware is sold to home centers, online and specialty retailers. One-time product sales that repeat with repainting and remodeling; seasonally strongest in Q2 and Q3.
businessLines.description: Architectural coatings (Behr, Kilz, Whizz paints, primers, stains, applicators) plus cabinet and door hardware, hook and hook-rail products and outdoor living hardware (Liberty, Franklin Brass) and decorative bath hardware.

revenue.note: FY2024 $2,975M (-14%). Architectural coatings were about 31 percent of consolidated net sales in 2025 (32 percent in 2024 and 2023). Six months to 2026-06-30: $1,209M vs $1,234M.
